description: Land Acquisition - Dippitiya, Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for a public purpose (construction of an access road). It contains a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act with detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister, the core content focuses on land matters rather than government personnel changes or structural adjustments, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
